samples.text: 请不要发送草稿；只有我确认后，才把最终版发给客户。
semantic_anchors: Do not send the draft.
Send the final version to the client only after the speaker confirms.

samples.text: Maya lent me her adapter, but I have not returned it yet.
semantic_anchors: Maya is the lender and the speaker is the borrower.
The adapter has not been returned yet.

samples.text: 三个文件中只有第二个需要重命名，另外两个保持不变。
semantic_anchors: Exactly three files.
Only the second needs renaming; the other two remain unchanged.

samples.text: Could you move our meeting from Tuesday morning to Thursday afternoon, without changing the room?
semantic_anchors: A polite request, not an already completed change.
Move from Tuesday morning to Thursday afternoon.
Keep the same room.

samples.text: 如果下载中断，就保留已经下载的部分；不要自动切换到别的模型。
semantic_anchors: Conditional on an interrupted download.
Keep the downloaded portion.
Do not automatically switch to another model.

samples.text: The refund is $18.50, not $80.50, and it should arrive within three working days.
semantic_anchors: Refund amount is 18.50 dollars, explicitly not 80.50.
Expected arrival within three working days, not three calendar days.

samples.text:
请先联系小林，再联系小周。
订单号是 A-204；详情见 https://example.com/order/A-204 。
semantic_anchors: Contact Xiaolin before Xiaozhou.
Preserve order identifier A-204 and the URL exactly.
Preserve the CRLF boundary.

samples.text:
Please keep the backup.
Do not delete report_v2.csv or change @Mira's access.
semantic_anchors: Keep the backup.
Do not delete report_v2.csv.
Do not change @Mira's access.
Preserve outer spaces, CRLF and protected identifiers.

samples.text: 我不是说她同意了，我只是说她还没有回复。
semantic_anchors: The speaker is not asserting that she agreed.
She has not replied yet, which is not a refusal or agreement.

samples.text: Unless the client approves the draft, we will keep the current version online.
semantic_anchors: Keep the current version online unless the client approves the draft.
No claim that approval has already happened.

samples.text: 能麻烦你检查一下附件吗？不着急，明天下班前告诉我就行。
semantic_anchors: Polite request to check the attachment.
Not urgent; response by the end of the recipient's workday tomorrow.
Do not invent an exact clock time.

samples.text: I used to work remotely, but now I go to the office twice a week.
semantic_anchors: Remote work was the previous arrangement.
The speaker now goes to the office twice each week.
Do not invert remote and office frequency.

samples.text: 取消这次操作，不要删除账户，也不要清空其他设置。
semantic_anchors: Cancel only this operation.
Do not delete the account or clear other settings.

samples.text: The package arrived, but the replacement cable was missing. Please send only the cable.
semantic_anchors: The package did arrive.
The replacement cable was missing.
Request to send only the cable, not another complete package.

samples.text: 这个接口只读取状态，不会保存密码或上传输入内容。
semantic_anchors: The interface only reads status.
It does not save passwords or upload input content.

samples.text: Please review the change before merging it; approval to test is not approval to publish.
semantic_anchors: Review before merging.
Permission to test does not grant permission to publish.
